I'll first confirm whether `safe_divide` exists anywhere in the installed package, since that affects whether these obligations can be discharged at all.

```python
import subprocess, sys, pathlib

root = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix) / "lib" / "python3.12" / "site-packages" / "tablegpt"
hits = subprocess.run(["grep", "-rn", "-E", "safe_divide|def divide", str(root)],
                      capture_output=True, text=True)
print("returncode:", hits.returncode)
print("stdout:", hits.stdout or "(no matches)")
print("stderr:", hits.stderr or "(none)")
print()
print("definitions found in utils.py:",
      [l.split("def ")[1].split("(")[0]
       for l in (root / "utils.py").read_text().splitlines() if l.startswith("def ")])
```
